answer: A transitive trust network deters Sybil attacks by routing interactions through peer-vouched credit paths. An adversary incurs the scarce cost of obtaining authentic endorsements from established peers, as synthetic links cannot bridge topological cut-edges. Refracted through an analytical prism, trust updates ripple only across verified ties, preventing an unvetted thread of cloned identities from gaining influence. However, this creates severe cold-start friction for honest newcomers.
